title: Iran says it hits US military targets in Gulf, prepares to bury slain leader
summary: Iranian armed forces launched attacks on U.S. military infrastructure in neighboring Gulf states on Thursday following U.S. strikes on Iran, putting further strain on a three-week-old ceasefire agreement.

title: Locked out after a hack? The fix may be hiding on your phone
summary: After a hacker took over a woman's Amazon account, her reset password codes were being sent — but her phone had quietly filtered them into a text-message spam folder.
